debug_all_log.description: Path to file for all debug output. Empty string means stdout.

debug_warn_log.description: Path to file for warnings level debug output. Empty string means stderr.

debug_info_log.description: Path to file for information level debug output. Empty string means stderr.

debug_fine_log.description: Path to file for fine level debug output. Empty string means stderr.

debug_finer_log.description: Path to file for finer level debug output. Empty string means stderr.

debug_finest_log.description: Path to file for finest level debug output. Empty string means stderr.

reset_defaults.description: Return user settings to their safe defaults on startup.

clear_cache.description: Clears the Tor cache on startup.

cleanup.description: Cleans up after a bad shutdown which may have left system proxy in an unknown state.

default_proxy_quiet.description: Set system proxy back to its defaults quietly, without GUI dialog.

restore_proxy_quiet.description: Attempt to restore proxy to its last known settings using a previously saved backup, without GUI dialog.

update_disable.description: Disables the version update checking at startup and removes the option from preferences.

proxy_rules.description: List of proxy rules to apply. Format: 'protocol:host:port'.
